title: AttestationChain
description:
Full provenance attestation chain (decomposition §1, item 14 (+);
whitepaper §9).

Each field is a content-addressed ref or signature blob representing one
link in the provenance chain.

Frozen by WP-00.

def.description: Content-addressed ref / digest of the CheckDef used.

model.description: Model identifier used in any AI-driven step of the pipeline.

principal.description: Ordered chain of principals who triggered or approved this chain.

runner.description: Content-addressed ref identifying the runner that executed the check.

sig.description:
Detached signature over the concatenated refs (format: base64-encoded
Ed25519 or ECDSA-P256 signature).

tree.description: Content-addressed ref to the workspace tree snapshot.
